svg.title: P1 — PLACE reading order and the compact circle summary on phone 375x812
svg.desc: Annotated wireframe comparing the shipped PLACE reading order at 375x812 with the proposed compact circle summary, showing that the summary is a second projection of the same four evidence objects and not a new index.

WHY THE CHIP IS NOT ENOUGH
The #86 quick-jump chip scrolls to the figures. It is a
shortcut past a problem, not a fix for it: the order is
unchanged and the chip itself is below the 44 px floor.
ROOT CAUSE OF THE 30 px CHIP
css/app.css:978 already declares a universal coarse-
pointer floor — but with :where(…), which has zero
specificity. The class rule .place-jump-chip{min-
height:30px} at line 850 therefore wins. The fix is to
raise that one declaration, not to add a new rule.
PROPOSED · the circle answers first, everything else keeps its place

5 · ▸ Detail · 6 · Context · 7 · Controls — order after step 1 is unchanged
THE SUMMARY IS A PROJECTION, NOT AN OBJECT
It renders the same four evidence objects from the same
state in the same render pass as the block at step 4.
It introduces no combined index, no score, no ranking and
no new measurement. It cannot disagree with step 4,
because there is only one source of truth behind both.
RULES THE COMPACT SUMMARY MUST OBEY

g.text: R1 · Four figures and the radius. Nothing else.
Tourism POIs, Hotels & stays, Mobility nodes, Mean UTCI, plus “◎ 900 m radius”. No fifth number, no total, no average.
R2 · Abstention and OFF survive compression.
UTCI reads “—” with its state, never 0 and never blank. A layer that is OFF says OFF. Missing is never zero.
R3 · Provenance is reachable from the summary itself.
One ⓘ on the band opens Evidence & limits scoped to the Lens-circle surfaces. Per-figure ⓘ stays on the block at step 4.
R4 · The scope label is on the band, not inferred.
“IN THIS LENS CIRCLE · ◎ 900 m radius” — so it can never be read as the barrio, the ámbito or the municipality.
R5 · ≤850 px only; it is additive, never a replacement.
Desktop is unchanged. The full block at step 4 is never hidden at any width, so the IA no-hide contract still passes.
R6 · The radius is the live radius, not the default.
If the user sets 2 km, the band says 2 km. A stale “900 m” beside live figures would be a false reading.

svg.text: WHAT P1 DOES NOT DO
✗ It does not reorder the administrative area, planning ámbito and licence sections relative to each other.
✗ It does not move controls out of last position.
✗ It does not remove, shorten or paraphrase a single interpretation ceiling. (Thinning inline caveat density is P2 #8.)
✗ It does not add a mode, a dataset, an indicator or a fourth product scope.
✗ It does not touch HATI, which stays a frozen, independent, optional ON/OFF research layer.
HEIGHT COST AT 375 × 812
The panel is a 42dvh bottom sheet ≈ 341 px. The sticky head grows by 14 px (chips 30 → 44 px) and the summary band
adds 64 px + 8 px margin. Net: ≈ 86 px of the sheet is spent buying the answer the user came for, and the material it
displaces is pushed down the same internal scroll it already lived on — nothing leaves the document.
Open question for the implementation PR: whether the panel should also be allowed to grow to ~48dvh at ≤560 px.
That trades map area for panel area and should be decided against a real device, not against emulation.
BILINGUAL NOTE
The Spanish band label “EN ESTE CÍRCULO DE LENTE · ◎ 900 m de radio” is ~22 % longer than the English. The band is
designed to wrap its label to two lines rather than truncate, because a truncated scope label is a lost scope label.
Panel geometry from css/app.css: ≤850 px .panel{max-height:42dvh} · ≤850 px and ≤700 px tall {max-height:44dvh} · .place-jump-chip{min-height:30px} at line 850 · :where() floor at line 978.
Figures 41 / 63 / 24 are illustrative layout placeholders and are NOT evidence readings. The 9-ámbito membership count IS model-derived.
Height figures are layout arithmetic from the shipped stylesheet, not rendered measurements on a device.
NOT TESTED: no human user, no real iPhone/iPad hardware, no assistive technology. Proposed design only.
